name: How does Kelby Contreras at Realty ONE Group Evolution assist with 1031 exchange properties?

mainEntity.name: How does Kelby Contreras at Realty ONE Group Evolution assist with 1031 exchange properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kelby Contreras and Realty ONE Group Evolution assist clients navigating 1031 exchanges by providing expert guidance in identifying and acquiring suitable 'like-kind' replacement properties across our service areas, including Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties. We specialize in understanding the local market nuances in areas like Doral, Midtown/Wynwood, or Williams Island to help you meet the strict 45-day identification deadline. While we don't provide tax or legal advice, we collaborate with your Qualified Intermediary and other professionals to ensure a seamless real estate transaction process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kelby Contreras assists 1031 exchange clients by identifying and acquiring suitable replacement properties across service areas, understanding local market nuances to meet deadlines.
